title: Ezra Arrives in Jerusalem

questions.question: Who was Ezra's ancestor?
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:5 (ESV): "...son of Aaron the chief priest."

questions.question: What was Ezra skilled in?
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:6 (ESV): "...He was a scribe skilled in the Law of Moses..."

questions.question: Why did the king grant him all that he asked?
options: For the hand of the LORD his God was on him
questions.correctAnswer: For the hand of the LORD his God was on him
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:6 (ESV): "...and the king granted him all that he asked, for the hand of the LORD his God was on him."

questions.question: To what had Ezra set his heart?
options: To study the Law of the LORD, and to do it and to teach his statutes
questions.correctAnswer: To study the Law of the LORD, and to do it and to teach his statutes
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:10 (ESV): "For Ezra had set his heart to study the Law of the LORD, and to do it and to teach his statutes..."

questions.question: Which king gave Ezra a letter?
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:11 (ESV): "This is a copy of the letter that King Artaxerxes gave to Ezra..."

questions.question: How long did the journey take?
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:9 (ESV): "...and on the first day of the fifth month he came to Jerusalem..." (Started first day of first month).

questions.question: What authority did Artaxerxes give Ezra regarding magistrates and judges?
options: To appoint them to judge all the people in the province Beyond the River
questions.correctAnswer: To appoint them to judge all the people in the province Beyond the River
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:25 (ESV): "...appoint magistrates and judges who may judge all the people in the province Beyond the River..."

questions.question: What was the punishment for those who did not obey the law of God and the king?
options: Death, banishment, confiscation of goods, or imprisonment
questions.correctAnswer: Death, banishment, confiscation of goods, or imprisonment
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:26 (ESV): "...let judgment be strictly executed on him, whether for death or for banishment or for confiscation of goods or for imprisonment."

questions.question: Who freely offered silver and gold to the God of Israel?
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:15 (ESV): "...the silver and gold that the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel..."

questions.question: What exemption was granted to the priests, Levites, singers, etc.?
options: It shall not be lawful to impose tribute, custom, or toll on them
questions.correctAnswer: It shall not be lawful to impose tribute, custom, or toll on them
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:24 (ESV): "...it shall not be lawful to impose tribute, custom, or toll on them."

questions.question: What limit was placed on the treasurers regarding supply to Ezra?
options: 100 talents of silver, 100 cors of wheat, 100 baths of wine/oil
questions.correctAnswer: 100 talents of silver, 100 cors of wheat, 100 baths of wine/oil
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:22 (ESV): "up to 100 talents of silver, 100 cors of wheat, 100 baths of wine, 100 baths of oil..."

questions.question: In which year of Artaxerxes did Ezra go up?
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:7 (ESV): "And there went up also... in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king."

questions.question: Why did Artaxerxes want everything commanded by God to be done diligently?
options: For why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?
questions.correctAnswer: For why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:23 (ESV): "...For why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?"

questions.question: Who did Ezra gather to go with him according to the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:28 (ESV): "...I gathered leading men from Israel to go up with me."

questions.question: What is the full title of the law Ezra was skilled in?
options: The Law of the LORD, the God of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: The Law of the LORD, the God of Israel
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:6 (ESV): "...He was a scribe skilled in the Law of Moses that the LORD, the God of Israel, had given..."

key_verse_text: For Ezra had set his heart to study the Law of the LORD, and to do it and to teach his statutes and rules in Israel.
